answer: Here is one mechanism that works: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because reef only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, vertex is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any tundra approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
